message: The other day, I was trying to explain to my kids why we need smoke alarms and an escape plan. Of course, they thought it was just another boring adult lecture. So, I decided to spice it up by turning it into a little game. We practiced our escape route, pretending we were secret agents on a mission. Turns out, they loved it and now remind me to check the smoke alarms regularly! It’s funny how a little creativity can make safety fun. How do you keep your kids engaged in safety talks?
